b: I read this in a book about 20 or 25 years ago and was sold as true. The metals dealer was apparently Jewish. He might have actually been a German ex-pat. Supposedly he had seen the price of uranium ore soaring and he didn’t know why. Investigating, the dealer learned that the Germans were buying up all the uranium ore they could find. Figuring that if the Germans wanted it they must be up to no good he decided to take as much of it off the market as he could afford to. He did not know anything about its use as fuel for a nuclear bomb. When the U.S. government investigated the sudden shortage in uranium ore they turned up at the metals dealer warehouse in New Jersey. Confronting the man, the dealer supposedly said something like ”Took you long enough.” and he sold the ore to the United Stares.
Is there any truth to this story?
